paper.title: PersonaAgent: Bridging Memory and Action for Personalized LLM Agents
paper.central_claim: PersonaAgent以持久用户persona连接episodic/semantic memory及固定工具动作，通过近期交互的文本梯度对齐提升多任务个性化，并兼顾效率与冷启动。

provenance.notes: 派发上下文标示sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无独立模型回执、可验证会话ID或receipt，故置null；未探测模型。分段续接同attempt，未读已完成两篇JSON。

sections_read: Appendices A–M including full prompts/cases and Tables 4–6
materials.notes: 全文和全部附录完整读取；无page_images；不根据图caption杜撰曲线数值。

evidence.quote: a unique system prompt for each user serving as an intermediary that continuously evolves by integrating user-data-driven memory to guide agent actions and refining the memory based on the action results.
evidence.support_explanation: 用户级非权重更新对象，非一次回答内自纠错。

evidence.quote: In PersonaAgent, semantic memory abstracts and consolidates stable user traits, such as enduring preferences and long-term goals, into a compact profile that persists across sessions.
evidence.support_explanation: 跨会话profile留存；双层语义/episodic而非模型权重。

claims.text: persona+记忆+动作对齐改善个性化

claims.result_denominator: LaMP1Acc .919 vs MemBank .862，去alignment .894；2M .513 vs .470，去alignment .487；3MAE .241 vs .321；100用户非完整任务样本分母
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在固定LaMP回放协议作者报告改善，消融支持persona与历史对齐有用；不证明在线漂移适应或普遍真实满意度

claims.setting: AppendixL统一运行环境；M每用户10历史事件
claims.selection_vs_test: 逐样本推理计时；异步对齐排除响应关键路径，不是总计算
claims.result_denominator: 平均1.79s vs PAG1.24/ReAct2.61/MemBank2.92；冷启动重采样未给重复误差
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在线路径较agentic对照快、较PAG慢；不能证明全生命周期计算更低或真实部署鲁棒
